summary: Reconciler now selects one canonical public-canary worker reply per human message by terminal outcome, generation and return time, then supersedes older automatic public retry projections while preserving all durable RETURN evidence. Added regression for BOUNDARY/STALE/DONE -> exactly one DONE PONG. Existing flat G000003 DONE result_ref was verified durable; the defect was duplicate retry projection, not missing evidence.
tests: PASS_STATIC: canonical winner ranking prefers DONE/PASS over PARTIAL/STALE/BOUNDARY, then generation and returned_at.
PASS_ISOLATED_SMOKE: exact supersession helper removed two retry projections and retained one canonical DONE worker reply.
NOT_RUN_REPOSITORY_TEST: local checkout failed DNS resolution for github.com, so no repository_test_runtime claim is made.
remaining_boundary: Run scripts/reconcile-primary-chat-returns.mjs against a real repository checkout, execute primary_chat_canary_retry_supersession_v1.mjs, and persist the resulting mirror update. Until then the current durable mirror still contains historical retry projections and the job is not DONE.
